text: PCA standardized metrics. component weighted combination metrics, chosen capture much remaining variance possible. first component carries half variance. eigenvalue--one rule, two components worth keeping; together hold 80% variance. code: pca <- prcomp( X, scale. = TRUE )  var_share <- pca$sdev^2 / sum( pca$sdev^2 )  data.frame( component  = paste0( "PC", seq_along( var_share ) ),             eigenvalue = pca$sdev^2,             share      = var_share,             cumulative = cumsum( var_share ) ) |>   knitr::kable( digits = 3 ) scree <- data.frame( k = seq_along( var_share ), share = var_share )  ggplot( scree, aes( k, share ) ) +   geom_line( colour = "#3266ad", linewidth = 0.9 ) +   geom_point( colour = "#3266ad", size = 2 ) +   scale_x_continuous( breaks = scree$k ) +   scale_y_continuous( labels = scales::label_percent() ) +   labs( x = "Component", y = "Share of variance" ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme( panel.grid.minor = element_blank() ) round( pca$rotation[ , 1:3 ], 2 ) |> knitr::kable() L <- data.frame( metric = rownames( pca$rotation ), pca$rotation[ , 1:2 ] ) L <- tidyr::pivot_longer( L, c( PC1, PC2 ), names_to = "component",                           values_to = "loading" ) L$metric <- factor( L$metric, levels = rev( rownames( pca$rotation ) ) )  ggplot( L, aes( loading, metric ) ) +   geom_col( fill = "#3266ad", width = 0.7 ) +   geom_vline( xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40" ) +   facet_wrap( ~ component ) +   labs( x = "Loading", y = NULL ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme( panel.grid.major.y = element_blank() )

title: npcompete (development version)
text: npc_build_metrics() builds every metric set years, CBSAs counties several resources , long table wide tables get_all_metrics(), optionally written disk manifest build. npc_build_archive() converts SOI panel sample frame CSV Parquet archive partitioned year; npc_get_orgs() reads years requested. npc_standardize(), npc_archive_dir() npc_archive_info() support . Metric tables now include national row (GEO = "", SUB = ""). check_year_completeness() judges years typical count substantial years, tail nearly empty early years longer hides incomplete ones. Faster rollups data.table grouping. live NCCS source registered grassroots universes planned; requesting gives informative error.

title: npcompete (development version)
text: concentration metrics share one set helpers one API: geography, subsector, resource year arguments, SUB = "" GEO = "" rollups. get_scale_free_density() now fits count models (negative binomial default, Poisson) full market frame includes markets organizations, keeps national rows models, reports density index observed / expected - 1. original log-linear model available model = "loglinear". get_kwoka() uses standard Kwoka (1977) index, sum squared gaps successive shares. Single-organization markets get NHHI = 1, consistent HHI, CRk Kwoka. New check_year_completeness(); get_all_metrics() drops incomplete years default. New dataset npo_panel_sample (Vermont 501(c)(3) filers, 2015-2019) examples tests. testthat suite hand-computed values every metric.
